description: This file defines a React component 'PanesSystemComponent' responsible for rendering and managing a pane-based layout, including navigation, content list, and editor panes. It handles pane transitions with animations, responsive layout adjustments, and panel resizing events.

methods.name: computeStylesForContainer
methods.description: Calculates and returns CSS styles for the main container grid layout based on the current state of panes and device type.

methods.name: computeClassesForPane
methods.description: Determines CSS classes for individual pane components, adjusting for mobile or desktop layout and whether the pane is pending entrance.

methods.name: computeClassesForContainer
methods.description: Returns CSS class name for the outer container, adjusting for mobile layouts.
